#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a Team Meeting calendar event for next Wednesday, 3-4 PM local time."""
import os
import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone

try:
    from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
except ImportError:
    ZoneInfo = None

OUTPUT = "team_meeting.ics"


def get_local_zone_name():
    if ZoneInfo is None:
        return "UTC"
    candidates = []
    try:
        from tzlocal import get_localzone
        candidates.append(str(get_localzone()))
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        with open("/etc/timezone", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            candidates.append(f.read().strip())
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        link = os.readlink("/etc/localtime")
        if "zoneinfo/" in link:
            candidates.append(link.split("zoneinfo/")[-1])
    except Exception:
        pass
    for c in candidates:
        try:
            ZoneInfo(c)
            return c
        except Exception:
            continue
    return "UTC"


def next_wednesday(today):
    # Wednesday is weekday() == 2. Next occurrence strictly after today.
    days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def ics_escape(text):
    return (
        text.replace("\\", "\\\\")
        .replace(";", "\\;")
        .replace(",", "\\,")
        .replace("\n", "\\n")
    )


def main():
    zone_name = get_local_zone_name()
    tz = ZoneInfo(zone_name) if ZoneInfo is not None else timezone.utc

    wed = next_wednesday(date.today())
    start_local = datetime(wed.year, wed.month, wed.day, 15, 0, tzinfo=tz)
    end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=1)

    uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@example.com"
    dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    start_str = start_local.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
    end_str = end_local.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")

    if zone_name != "UTC":
        dtstart_line = f"DTSTART;TZID={zone_name}:{start_str}"
        dtend_line = f"DTEND;TZID={zone_name}:{end_str}"
        human_start = start_local.strftime("%A, %B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p %Z (%z)")
    else:
        dtstart_line = f"DTSTART:{start_local.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}"
        dtend_line = f"DTEND:{end_local.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}"
        human_start = start_local.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%A, %B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p UTC")

    summary = "Team Meeting"
    description = "Weekly team sync (1 hour)."

    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "METHOD:PUBLISH",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
        dtstart_line,
        dtend_line,
        f"SUMMARY:{ics_escape(summary)}",
        f"DESCRIPTION:{ics_escape(description)}",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "BEGIN:VALARM",
        "ACTION:DISPLAY",
        "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting starting soon",
        "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
        "END:VALARM",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
    ]
    content = "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"

    with open(OUTPUT, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        f.write(content)

    print(f"Wrote {OUTPUT}")
    print(f"Zone: {zone_name}")
    print(f"Start: {human_start}")
    print(f"End:   {end_local.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p %Z (%z)')}")
    print("---")
    print(content)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
